title: Why One-off AI Training Will Not Prepare Teachers
body_markdown:
**Key Takeaways:**


- K-12 districts are expanding AI training for teachers through workshops, guidance, and approved tools, but educators often struggle to apply what they learn to everyday classroom decisions.
- Research from Digital Promise suggests AI training is most useful when connected to real instructional needs, allowing educators to explore tools while addressing specific teaching challenges.
- One-time workshops are not enough to build effective AI skills. Teachers need ongoing opportunities to experiment and evaluate AI-generated content.


[Read Full Article](https://www.eschoolnews.com/digital-learning/2026/11/03/why-one-off-ai-training-will-not-prepare-teachers/)
